development: Synthetic Alpha/Bravo/Cedar/Delta fixtures in test_relation_queries.py, separate from observed relation_v1 corpus/questions.
run_contract: All 48 observed bilingual queries: text-only scope/role parsing; graph public retrieval/API/hybrid caller parity; gold relation slots used only for post-result checks. Hybrid k=4 and other routes k=5; positive qrels all <=4.
limitations: Observed development/regression questions, not an unseen test or independent human gold.
Restricted English/Chinese grammar for 3 relation families, not general natural-language understanding.
Source event scan is a distinct retrieval strategy, not an improvement to BM25/dense/RRF ranking.
Graph and hybrid route to the same relation engine; their parity is integration coverage, not independent algorithm evidence.
Pure vector relation queries now return unknown without a source verifier; no inference of true absence.
Parser-derived facts remain shared with AI labels; production provider services are not restarted by the regression.
